status: proposed; not run; Phase 4 input from packet S4
target: Ableton Live 12 Suite 12.4.3 (2026-07-07_e3d8be4d07), macOS host only
common_prerequisites: Pin Live executable SHA-256 52289af638f1b26590c84a9bc08eabdc35127883087057add909d2718a7a35ef before the sitting
Establish, before relying on it, a virtual MIDI loopback port on the macOS host (for example the IAC Driver); availability is unverified
Fresh Live preferences copy per probe or record the preferences file hash before/after; retain Log.txt, the profile bytes and a screen capture for every probe
Assign each profile to a fresh User Remote Scripts directory; record how the surface was selected (Preferences > Link, Tempo & MIDI) and that Live was restarted after writing it

probes.question: Is a User Remote Scripts directory containing UserConfiguration.txt listed as a Control Surface, under exactly which displayed name, and is a restart required?
probes.existing_evidence: D1 HowTo L13-22; _UserScript get_name_for_script L30-47 builds a class name (spaces -> underscores, SyntaxError -> GenericScript); Live.arm64 strings 'MidiRemoteScripts: Scanning for scripts in folder ' @96219912 region, 'UserScripts: ' and 'HIDE_SCRIPT' @96220482 region
probes.why_static_insufficient: Enumeration and list display live in native AMidiRemoteScriptPackages/TMidiRemoteScript code; the Python name is a class name, not proven to be the displayed name
probes.minimal_input: Two directories: 'S4 Probe' and 'S4Probe2', each with a UserConfiguration.txt containing only [Globals] GlobalChannel: 0
probes.discriminating_observation: Displayed entries 'S4 Probe' vs 'S4_Probe' (and presence of S4Probe2) in the Control Surface menu before and after a restart
probes.stopping_condition: One launch without restart after creating the folders and one after restart, both captured; stop

probes.question: Are directories whose names start with a digit, underscore or non-ASCII letter listed, and in what order?
probes.existing_evidence: D1 L17-18 advises a leading letter; no code path traced
probes.why_static_insufficient: Name filtering and sort order are native (same boundary as PRB-S4-01)
probes.minimal_input: Directories '1Probe', '_Probe', 'Éprobe', 'Aprobe', 'bprobe' each with the PRB-S4-01 file
probes.discriminating_observation: Which of the five appear and their order in the menu
probes.stopping_condition: One restart-and-capture; stop. Run only after PRB-S4-01 shows listing works

probes.question: What does the host do when profile construction raises (any assignment from that profile active, surface listed/selectable, message shown)?
probes.existing_evidence: create_instance L75-339 has no exception table, so configparser read_file errors (DuplicateOptionError, MissingSectionHeaderError), getboolean ValueError and pad getint ValueError propagate (re-decoded); Live.arm64 string "Script could not be loaded." adjacent to 'create_instance' @96257008
probes.why_static_insufficient: The caller of create_instance is native TMidiRemoteScript; its recovery and UI are not in Python
probes.minimal_input: Profile with [MixerControls] MasterVolumeSlider: 20 and a duplicated line 'MasterVolumeSlider: 21'; control profile identical without the duplicate
probes.discriminating_observation: Log.txt entry text, any on-screen message, whether CC20/CC21 on channel 0 moves master volume, whether the surface stays selected
probes.stopping_condition: Duplicate-option variant first; add 'Pad1Note: abc' and 'MixerButtonsToggle: maybe' variants only if the first outcome is not a uniform load failure; stop after three variants

probes.question: What happens to a control whose mode token is unrecognized (for example lowercase 'absolute')?
probes.existing_evidence: parse_map_mode L52 returns the string 'Absolute' (not the MapMode value) for unknown tokens; EncoderElement.__init__ L53-56 stores it as the map mode
probes.why_static_insufficient: The string reaches native Live.MidiMap mapping installation; type handling is native
probes.minimal_input: [MixerControls] VolumeMapMode: absolute, MasterVolumeSlider: 20, TrackMuteButton1: 30 (mode-independent witness); send CC20 = 0 then 127 and CC30 = 127 on channel 0
probes.discriminating_observation: Master volume moves (as if Absolute) or not; track 1 mute toggles or not (whole profile failed vs one control); Log.txt errors

probes.question: For Absolute mode, which displayed master-volume value results from CC values 0, 64 and 127?
probes.existing_evidence: Mapping mode is passed to native MidiMap (ButtonElement.message_map_mode L113-116, EncoderElement L60-62); no Python arithmetic for Absolute
probes.why_static_insufficient: Value-to-parameter scaling is native MidiMap code; numerical fidelity requires measurement under ADR 0002
probes.minimal_input: [MixerControls] MasterVolumeSlider: 20; send CC20 = 0, 64, 127 on channel 0, one at a time
probes.discriminating_observation: Master volume display string after each value
probes.stopping_condition: Three readings; stop. Relative/14-bit modes only after a separate decision

probes.question: Do Play, Stop, Rec, Loop and Metro buttons change the named transport states as the static path predicts, including repeated positive values and zero?
probes.existing_evidence: ToggleComponent._on_button_value L93-100; TransportComponent.__init__ L63-81 binds song properties; D7
probes.why_static_insufficient: Property setters (is_playing, record_mode, loop, metronome) are native Live API; dispatch of MIDI to the script is native
probes.minimal_input: [TransportControls] PlayButton: 61, StopButton: 60, LoopButton: 66, MetroButton: 65; sequence 127,0,127 on each; empty set
probes.discriminating_observation: Transport play state, Loop and Metronome switch states after each message
probes.stopping_condition: One pass of the sequence per button; stop

probes.question: What seek rate does a held Rwd/Ffwd produce, what does a held Nudge do, and how does TapTempo estimate tempo?
probes.existing_evidence: TransportComponent _ffwd_value/_rwd_value L193-222 use Task-based progression; BC-08
probes.why_static_insufficient: Scheduler cadence and the time unit of song time moves are runtime properties
probes.minimal_input: FfwdButton: 68 held (127) for 2.0 s then 0, from song position 1.1.1, tempo 120
probes.discriminating_observation: Song position after release; repeat once to estimate jitter
probes.stopping_condition: Two holds; stop. Nudge and tap only if a contract needs them

probes.question: Does a configured pad note play the visible Drum Rack pad at the documented position, and what happens on note-off?
probes.existing_evidence: create_instance L210-213 builds (col,row,note,channel); ControlSurface.build_midi_map L372-373 hands it to c_instance.set_pad_translation; 'OMidiPadTranslator' strings in Live.arm64 near @96256717
probes.why_static_insufficient: Translation to Drum Rack pads is native
probes.minimal_input: [Globals] GlobalChannel: 0, Pad1Note: 60, Pad16Note: 75; Drum Rack with distinct samples on the visible 16 pads; send note-on 60 vel 100 then note-off
probes.discriminating_observation: Which pad lights/plays (top-left vs bottom-left) for Pad1 and Pad16

probes.question: Which parameters do encoders 1-8 address on one built-in device, and what happens with fewer parameters than encoders?
probes.existing_evidence: _Framework/DeviceComponent imports _Generic.Devices bank tables (Python, untraced in S4)
probes.why_static_insufficient: Not yet insufficient: trace _Generic/Devices first; probe only if name-to-parameter resolution (native) remains material
probes.minimal_input: Encoder1-8: 10-17 with Auto Filter selected; send CC10..17 = 127 in turn
probes.discriminating_observation: Which parameter moves for each CC
probes.stopping_condition: Eight messages; stop. Deferred until the static trace is done

probes.question: Do Next/Prev bank, OnOff and Lock act as statically derived on a device with a known bank count, and what does Lock do on release and device deletion?
probes.why_static_insufficient: Bank count comes from device definitions plus native parameters; lock goes through native c_instance
probes.minimal_input: Encoder1: 10, NextBankButton: 50 (no PrevBankButton), OnOffButton: 53, LockButton: 52; device with 3 banks
probes.discriminating_observation: Bank shown after 4 Next presses (wrap expected), activator state after OnOff, encoder target after Lock then selecting another device

probes.question: Which tracks do mixer strips 1-8 control with return, group and hidden tracks present, and what does mixer bank Next do at the end?
probes.existing_evidence: GenericScript L233-302 builds 8 strips; MixerComponent track list not traced in S4
probes.why_static_insufficient: Track ordering source is a native song property; MixerComponent may be traceable first
probes.minimal_input: Set with 9 audio tracks (one folded group of 2), 2 returns; TrackSelectButton1-8: 30-37, NextBankButton: 38
probes.discriminating_observation: Selected track names after each select CC, before and after one Next press

probes.question: Do toggle-kind mixer buttons act on value 0, and do solo/arm exclusivity and arm-triggered track selection occur?
probes.existing_evidence: ChannelStripComponent _mute_value L367-370, _select_value L357-361; SelectChanStripComponent._arm_value L16-27 selects the track when arming succeeds and select_instrument returns true
probes.why_static_insufficient: Exclusivity preferences and select_instrument are native
probes.minimal_input: MixerButtonsToggle: True, TrackMuteButton1: 30, TrackArmButton2: 31; send 127 then 0 on each
probes.discriminating_observation: Mute state after each message (two inversions expected); track 2 armed and selected
probes.stopping_condition: One pass; repeat with MixerButtonsToggle: False only if outcome differs from prediction

probes.question: What MIDI bytes does Live send to a mute button for unmuted and muted tracks, with InvertMuteButtonFeedback True and False?
probes.existing_evidence: ChannelStripComponent._on_mute_changed L464-475 calls turn_on/turn_off; send path native
probes.why_static_insufficient: Output message construction is native; needs an output port capture
probes.minimal_input: TrackMuteButton1: 30, output port routed to a MIDI monitor; toggle mute in the UI
probes.discriminating_observation: CC30 value bytes for each mute state and each invert setting
probes.stopping_condition: Two settings x two states; stop

probes.question: Does editing UserConfiguration.txt take effect without restart, on surface reselection, or only after restart?
probes.existing_evidence: create_instance opens and parses the file once per construction (L85-94); when the host constructs is native
probes.minimal_input: Active profile MasterVolumeSlider: 20; edit to 21 while running
probes.discriminating_observation: Which CC moves master volume after edit, after reselect, after restart

probes.question: What happens to a held momentary transport button or held pad note when the MIDI port disconnects or the surface is deselected?
probes.existing_evidence: ButtonElement/ControlSurface disconnect paths exist; port lifecycle native
probes.why_static_insufficient: Port lifecycle and note cleanup are native and runtime
probes.minimal_input: NudgeUpButton: 71 held at 127; deselect the surface
probes.stopping_condition: One hold per teardown kind (deselect, port removal); stop

probes.why_static_insufficient: Locale/UTF-8 mode of the embedded interpreter is set by native startup code
probes.minimal_input: UTF-8 file with a comment line containing 'é' and MasterVolumeSlider: 20; then the same with a UTF-8 BOM
probes.discriminating_observation: Whether CC20 maps master volume in each file; Log.txt decode errors
